title: Fix Polli GIF inputs
author: Itachi-1824
pr_body_excerpt:
Discord GIFV embeds expose a static thumbnail and an MP4. Polli picked the MP4, sent it as an OpenAI `image_url`, then retried the same undecodable payload three times before showing the generic error.

This uses the embed's static WebP preview for vision and keeps raw video/GIF URLs as text context instead of pretending they're images. Added two regression tests for the exact extraction and message-building paths.

Replayed the original Klipy preview through Kimi: 200, correctly identified Buzz Lightyear.

gist.headline: Polli learns GIF etiquette
gist.blurb: Polli now gives Discord GIFV embeds the picture they actually need: the static preview. The video link still comes along as context, but nobody is asked to pretend an MP4 is a JPEG.
gist.summary: Fixed Polli's Discord GIFV handling so vision models receive the embed's static WebP thumbnail while raw MP4/GIF URLs are included as text context instead of invalid OpenAI image inputs.
gist.impact: Polli can now understand GIFV previews such as Klipy embeds without retrying an undecodable MP4 three times, including correctly identifying the original Buzz Lightyear test image through Kimi.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a thoughtful media librarian in a cozy garden-terminal nook, sorting a Discord-style GIFV card into a framed static preview and a labeled video-link note. A tiny retro monitor robot happily recognizes a pixel Buzz Lightyear-like space ranger silhouette from the preview, while code-plants and flowers grow around the desk; Polli wears small librarian glasses.
